axial: of or relating to or resembling an axis of rotation
axial flow turbine: An axial flow turbine operates in the exactly reverse of an axial flow compressor,

Whereas for an axial turbine the rotor is ‘impacted’ by the air flow, for a radial turbine, the flow is smoothly orientated at 90 degrees by the compressor towards the combustion chamber and driving the turbine in the same way water drives a watermill.

axial rotation: rotary motion of an object around its own axis
axial skeleton: the part of the skeleton that includes the skull and spinal column and sternum and ribs

axiom: a saying that is widely accepted on its own merits
axiomatic system: any set of axioms from which some or all axioms can be used in conjunction to logically derive theorems.

axonal: of or relating to or resembling an axon
ayah: (in India) a native nursemaid who looks after children
ayatollah: a high-ranking Shiite religious leader who is regarded as an authority on religious law and its interpretation and who has political power as well

azalea: any of numerous ornamental shrubs grown for their showy flowers of various colors
azide: a chemical compound containing the azido group combined with an element or radical
azimuth: the azimuth of a celestial body is the angle between the vertical plane containing it and the plane of the meridian
azimuth mark: The marked point, on an azimuth marker, for which the azimuth(s) to one or more distant points is (are) given.
An azimuth mark, together with its associated triangulation station, provides an accurate azimuth (like a compass direction) that is based on true North rather than magnetic North.
